rules.description: Managed challenge suspicious automation on auth routes
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/auth/") and (http.request.method in {"POST" "PUT" "PATCH" "DELETE"}) and ((not cf.client.bot) and (http.user_agent matches "(?i)(curl|wget|python|scrapy|sqlmap|nikto|nmap|masscan|zgrab|headless|postmanruntime|insomnia)"))
